checks.name: 固定四行动和二反应槽
点击槽打开装备库
候选悬停在右下显示炎爆效果
装备后出现对应规则设置
条件与目标实际写入装备槽
禁用该规则
顺序按钮移动整条规则
固定目标技能锁定目标选项
反应槽装备回能且显示固定时机
反应附加条件可调整
点击怪物建立优先标识
敌人被动意图和RP可查
敌人主动意图和AP可查
人物悬停统一详情面板
行动轴头像悬停统一详情面板
关闭点击选目标后仅查看
闪震和音效设置生效
保存后停止重开保持四加二规则及目标
重复反应交换装备槽而不浪费栏位
装备槽可卸下并保留四槽结构
超过AP预算明确提示
清除优先目标

params.code:
var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Slots").get_child_count()==4 and s.get_node("Reactions").get_child_count()==2

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Library").visible and s.selected_slot==0

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Details/Title").text=="炎爆" and s.get_node("Details/Text").text.contains("转移") and s.get_node("Details/Cost").text=="1 AP"

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.plan[0].id=="ignite" and s.get_node("Details/Config").visible

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.plan[0].condition==1 and s.plan[0].target==2

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return not s.plan[0].enabled

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.plan[1].id=="ignite" and s.plan[1].condition==1 and s.plan[0].id=="double"

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Details/Config/Target").disabled and s.get_node("Details/Config/Target").text=="燃烧最多"

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.passives[0].id=="mana" and s.get_node("Details/Config/Target").disabled and s.get_node("Reactions/P0/Cost").text.contains("AP 不足")

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.marked==1 and s.units[2].selected and s.units[2].get_node("Mark").visible

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Details/Title").text=="枯木护身" and s.get_node("Details/Cost").text=="1 RP"

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Details/Title").text=="横扫" and s.get_node("Details/Cost").text.contains("1 AP")

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Details/Title").text=="烬火法师" and s.get_node("Details/Cost").text.contains("RP")

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.get_node("Details/Title").text=="灰烬刺球"

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.marked==1 and not s.click_target and s.get_node("Details/Title").text=="枯枝稻人"

var s = get_tree().current_scene
return s.fx.reduced and not s.get_node("Settings/Sound").button_pressed

var s = get_tree().current_scene
